title: Protein French Toast
subtitle: Cottage cheese and egg batter for a high-protein griddle classic.
description: French toast built with extra protein — egg-heavy batter and Greek yogurt in the mix. Training-day breakfast that still tastes like weekend French toast.

ingredients.name: Whole Milk
ingredients.notes: plus 1 tsp vanilla and pinch of cinnamon

steps.title: Blend the batter
steps.instruction: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, milk, vanilla, cinnamon, and maple until completely smooth—no curds. Pour into a shallow hotel pan for fast dipping.

steps.title: Heat the griddle
steps.instruction: Heat a large griddle or cast iron over medium. Add butter until foaming but not brown. Work in batches so slices aren't crowded.

steps.title: Soak and griddle
steps.instruction: Dip bread 3–4 seconds per side—don't oversaturate or centers stay raw. Griddle 3 minutes per side until deep golden and custard sets; adjust heat if browning too fast.

steps.title: Hold warm
steps.instruction: Transfer finished slices to a wire rack on a sheet pan in a 200°F oven. Uncovered keeps the crust; cover only if holding longer than 20 minutes.

steps.title: Plate and serve
steps.instruction: Stack two slices per plate, top with berries and a drizzle of maple. Offer Greek yogurt for extra protein without slowing the line.

stationWorkflow: Blend batter first and keep the dip pan shallow so slices don't over-soak during rush assembly.
One cook griddles while another plates berries and maple—sync batches to two slices per firefighter.
Use a wire rack for holding; stacking hot French toast steams the crust soft before service.
cleanupNotes: Rinse the blender immediately with warm water before cottage cheese dries on the blade assembly.
Scrape the griddle while warm with a bench scraper, then wipe with a butter-damp towel.
leftovers: Reheat slices on a sheet pan at 325°F for 8 minutes directly on the rack for a crisp re-crisp.
Chop cold slices into a bread pudding base with extra eggs, milk, and raisins for tomorrow's bake.
imageAlt: Golden protein French toast stacks with fresh berries and maple drizzle
